title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Daniel Kahn is a partner at Davis Polk & Wardwell in the White Collar Defense and Investigations group. Professor Kahn represents individual and corporate clients in criminal and regulatory investigations, including matters relating to the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (“FCPA”) and allegations of fraud. Professor Kahn co-authored a treatise on Corporate Criminal Investigations. Prior to […]
